description: DGO Correspondence Mailer: operator sign-in. requestCode mails a one-time code to an active operator; verifyCode exchanges it for a session token; signOut ends it; admins manage DGOMailOperators.

error.message: This flow has not been configured: set operatorKey in Compose_Config (16+ characters, not starting with "__").

@if(outputs('Compose_Caller')?['lookupFailed'], 'The sign-in could not be checked just now (SharePoint did not answer). Nothing was done; try again in a moment.', 'Sign in first: the session is missing, has expired, was signed out, or its operator is no longer active.')
healthCheck must be called with validationOnly:true.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@concat('

Your sign-in code for the DGO Correspondence Mailer is:

', outputs('Compose_Challenge')?['code'], '

It works once, for ', string(outputs('Compose_Config')?['codeMinutes']), ' minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: nobody can sign in without the code.

')

data.message: If this address belongs to a mailer operator, a sign-in code has been mailed to it.

inputs.where: @or(equals(item()?['Status'], 'Revoked'), and(equals(item()?['Status'], 'RateLimit'), less(ticks(string(coalesce(item()?['CodeExpiresAt'], '1900-01-01T00:00:00Z'))), ticks(utcNow()))), and(contains(createArray('Pending', 'Locked'), string(item()?['Status'])), less(ticks(string(coalesce(item()?['CodeExpiresAt'], '1900-01-01T00:00:00Z'))), ticks(utcNow()))), and(equals(item()?['Status'], 'Active'), less(ticks(string(coalesce(item()?['TokenExpiresAt'], '1900-01-01T00:00:00Z'))), ticks(utcNow()))))

error.message: This code has expired, was already used, or had too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
Another try with this code is being checked. Wait a moment, then enter the code again.
This code has expired, was already used, or had too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.

@concat('That code is not right. ', string(max(0, sub(int(outputs('Compose_Config')?['maxCodeAttempts']), add(int(coalesce(body('SP_Read_Challenge_Version')?['d']?['Attempts'], 0)), 1)))), ' try(s) left for this code.')
Only a mailer admin can manage operators.
Only a mailer admin can manage operators.
payload.operator.email must be an email address.
@concat('Unsupported operation ''', outputs('Compose_Request')?['operation'], '''. Supported: ', 'verify, healthcheck, requestcode, verifycode, signout, whoami, listoperators, upsertoperator')
@concat('The flow failed before it could answer. Run id: ', workflow()?['run']?['name'])
